UPDATE usermember
id = #{id},
pw = #{pw},
name = #{name},
email = #{email},
carNum = #{carNum},
carTypes = #{carTypes}
WHERE seq = #{seq}
mapper.select: SELECT carNum, parkingFloor, entryTime, parkingZone FROM parking_records WHERE carNum = ( SELECT carNum FROM usermember WHERE id = #{id} ) AND exitTime IS NULL ORDER BY entryTime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id AS id, u.carNum AS carNum, u.carTypes AS carTypes, -- 1. 차량 번호 존재 여부 CASE WHEN u.carNum IS NOT NULL AND u.carNum != '' THEN true ELSE false END AS hasCar, -- 2. 오늘 날짜가 정기권 기간 내(startDate ~ endDate)에 들어오는지 체크 CASE WHEN p.regId IS NOT NULL AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN p.startDate AND p.endDate THEN true ELSE false END AS isPrepaid, p.startDate AS startDate, p.endDate AS endDate FROM usermember u LEFT JOIN prepaid p ON u.carNum = p.carNum AND p.status = 'APPROVED' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN p.startDate AND p.endDate WHERE u.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

select p.recordid AS "recordId", p.carnum AS "carNum", p.entrytime AS "entryTime", NOW()::timestamp AS "exitTime", FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - p.entrytime)) / 60) AS totalMin,
-- 요금 정책 데이터 f.graceperiod AS gracePeriod, f.basetime AS baseTime, f.basefee AS baseFee, f.extratime AS extraTime, f.extrafee AS extraFee, f.dailymax AS dailyMax,
-- 상가 할인 총합 COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(freemin) FROM store_discounts WHERE recordid = p.recordid ), 0) AS "storeDiscountMin",
-- [prepaid 테이블 반영] 정기권 유효 여부 (유효하면 true, 아니면 false) EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM prepaid pr WHERE pr.carnum = p.carnum AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN pr.startdate AND pr.enddate AND pr.status = 'approved' ) AS "isPass"
FROM parking_records p CROSS JOIN ( SELECT graceperiod, basetime, basefee, extratime, extrafee, dailymax FROM fee_policies ORDER BY policyid DESC LIMIT 1 ) f WHERE p.carnum = ( SELECT carnum FROM usermember WHERE id = #{id} ) AND p.exittime IS NULL ORDER BY p.entrytime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM parking_records WHERE carNum = #{carNum} AND exitTime IS NULL AND entryTime::date = CURRENT_DATE )
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM prepaid WHERE carNum = #{carNum} AND status = 'approved' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN startDate AND endDate )
